translation:
There are also those who in youth take metal-and-stone pills and powders; accumulating over a long time, they eat heat, which knots in the chest; the lower burner has vacuity-heat, and the blood and qi cannot control the stone; the heat and dryness are excessive in the stomach, hence they are thirsty and drink copiously.

If one drinks much water and urinates much, it is called wasting-thirst (消渴). If one eats much yet is not very hungry, urinates frequently, and gradually becomes emaciated, it is called wasting of the center (消中).
translator_notes: 消中 rendered as wasting of the center.
